items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: Well, he helped played with me. But he didn't like the idea of being with us much, you know.

ctx.x: What about Arnold Matoya? Did you ever use him? Well, he helped played with me. But he didn't like the idea of being with us much, you know. We didn't get too much about him. He was a real good corner player. Couldn't I use him? What did Buddy Petit play like? That always fascinates me. Oh, he was good.
